Subject: CAIQ - request for control rationales & evidence links

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the quick response on the questionnaire. As we move toward our security review for the October procurement window, the Acme security team has two asks that would help speed the assessment:

1) For a subset of high-risk CSA controls (specifically CCM CAI-01, INF-06, and DSP-02), can you provide short control rationales that explain how Redwood's architecture and processes satisfy the control? We prefer 3-5 sentence narratives tied to evidence artifacts.

2) A single evidence bundle or a SharePoint link with the corresponding artifacts (log retention policy excerpts, KMS rotation proof, SOC 2 report reference, config snapshots) so our reviewers can triage quickly.

If it helps, sample template columns are: control_id / short_rationale / primary_owner / artifact_name / artifact_link / last_updated.

Can you get an initial pass by EOD Monday (Jun 14)? We're aiming to schedule a 45-min walkthrough the week of Jun 21.

Appreciate it — happy to add more context if useful.

Best,
Liam

Grace / Liam — adding the initial technical rationales inline for quick triage.

> INF-06 (Logging and monitoring retention)
Our approach: logs are ingested into a centralized telemetry pipeline (Kafka -> Parquet store in GCS), and a 13-month retention policy is enforced by lifecycle rules. Access to raw logs is RBAC-controlled through Vault identities; retention rules are versioned and auditable in config repo (repo: infra/audit-retention v1.3). Evidence: logs-retention-policy.pdf (excerpt), bucket-lifecycle-config.json (snapshot), recent S3/GCS audit showing lifecycle transitions.

> DSP-02 (Data protection at rest)
Our approach: model weights and customer payloads at rest are encrypted using CMEK keys managed in AWS KMS / GCP KMS with automated rotation every 90 days. Disk and object encryption are enforced at provisioning time by policy engine (Terraform module: security/encryption). Evidence: kms-rotation-report-202706.pdf, terraform-plan-encryption.txt.

I added these into the crosswalk spreadsheet under controls INF-06 and DSP-02. Kimberly will add CAI-01 (control ownership / attestations).

Ben
